source.title: Dying Star's Waistlight — Wowhead Looter cumulative disenchanting table
source.author: Wowhead Looter (aggregated player submissions)

notes: Original item-specific Wowhead Looter cumulative table, cloth waist (priest); 45 source-reported item disenchant operations. Source row 1/3: Refulgent Crystal material occurrences 20 out of 45. Rows share a single cumulative item-level cohort, NOT independent casts. All rows have same displayed material name; linked output IDs and quality ranks are unavailable in indexed text. Do not assume row sequence equals rank 1/2/3 or collapse output rows. live page view is not proof of sample client build or PTR-origin observations. Actual gear bonus/ilvl variant, Enchanting skill/spec, source dates, stack yield, per-cast histogram, zero outcomes and current eligibility are unknown. One gear item per disenchant; Resourcefulness/refund data not reported. Research only, not a current live EV baseline.
